Developing and maintaining backend applications using Java and Spring Boot;
Working on legacy systems using Java, PrimeFaces, JSF, Hibernate, and JBoss/WildFly;
Creating and maintaining queries and scripts using Oracle SQL.

items.title: Barbearia Fernandes
items.description: Barbearia Fernandes is an application developed as part of the OneBit Empresa Jr trainee program to improve appointment management for barbershops.
